evaluations.claim: TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforms TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes.
evaluations.reality: TACRED-Revisit only slightly outperforms TACRED at K=16 and K=32, and the difference is less than 5%. At K=64, TACRED-Revisit performs worse than TACRED.

evaluations.claim: Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64.
evaluations.reality: Re-TACRED peaks at K=32 with a Micro F1 of approximately 51%, but its performance declines to around 47% at K=64.

evaluations.claim: SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64.
evaluations.reality: SemEval shows a consistent upward trend and reaches approximately 53% at K=64, outperforming Re-TACRED.
